# Functional boundary conformance

[Ordinary decision #80](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/80#issuecomment-6009479668)
precedes this boundary unit. The [Reference](../../../../docs/src/reference/functional-boundary.md)
specifies the currently admitted first-order/eager runtime calls and static
description calculus. The [criterion map](criterion-map-01.json) preserves all
14 original criteria. Broader builders, arrows, ADTs, traits and linear closures
remain separate feature work; this boundary introduces none of them.

The [integration manifest](validation-01/integration-validation-01.json) binds
performed commands and exact streams, declared source identities, independent
[Reference review](reference-review-01.json) and the
[first-source study](../../authoring_sessions/functional-boundary-v030/README.md).
All 114 sealed production build inputs remain unchanged. The original
preparation and its numerical law remain unexecuted beside the independently
refined exact-identity test; no first failure was invented for that revision.

Latest Rust and actual MSRV 1.85 each pass 47 unique tests: three new call/owner/
static-description controls, 13 body-effect tests, 15 operation-parameter tests,
12 quantum Unit map tests and four selected eager/recursion/shape/cycle controls.
Both all-target Cargo Clippy runs reject warnings; formatting passes. Negative
controls use an explicit absent checker so a native failure cannot stand for
the intended earlier source rejection. Static description reuse requests the
exact phase-fixed X-squared = +identity equation; Bell X readout is supplemental.
Other sized-source, QFT/native-only and capacity stress tests were not run here.

The study retains 44 actual CLI commands, ten initial projects and two complete
wrapper repairs. Twelve initial observer usage failures and the earlier direct
primitive-provider refusals remain unchanged. Corrected adapters, predictions
and repairs are separate. The sized runtime-if and static-constructor emitter
limits remain explicit; no weaker route is added. Four tiny execution controls
match their independent expectations, without inferring a general phase,
reference, source/runtime or closure theorem from histograms.

Authoring, edition, VM22/VM29 identity, constitutional continuity against reviewed
`faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2` and documentation checks pass. Fixed
mdBook 0.5.4 builds 27 HTML files; 1,104 local links and 412 anchors, including
print, pass. The original pre-review Reference/build capture remains; final
qualifications distinguish common judgment from finite/selected materialization
and runtime locals from callable static Op formals.

The [hosted predecessor review](hosted-predecessor-01/review-01.json) conclusively
matches MSRV's stale eight-versus-six corpus assertion to the #82 repair. The
distribution wrapper's inner source-test stderr was not inspected; its Cargo
exit 101 cannot establish an identical cause. Latest hosted CI still belongs
to the pushed #82 baseline, not this later local boundary unit.

External qargo/qlippy diagnostic integration is omitted under explicit human
authorization. Actual Qleisli diagnostics and explanations remain checked.
The two admitted QLV1 guarantees and QS/PR/RS/EXACT pending duties keep their
scopes and statuses. No new native acceptance logic, proof discharge, Guardian act,
fresh Lean build/audit/replay, full same-commit CI/distribution/installation or
release approval is claimed. QFT and new maximum-system generation are excluded.
